stories.headline: Pakistan highlights food-loss reduction on the International Day of Awareness of Food Loss and Waste
stories.summary: Pakistan marked the International Day of Awareness of Food Loss and Waste on 29 September 2026, with the official theme 'Stop food loss and waste. For the people. For the Planet.'
key_takeaways: The observance falls on 29 September.
The 2026 theme is 'Stop food loss and waste. For the people. For the Planet.'
Food-loss reduction links food security, resource efficiency and climate action.

sources.title: International Day of Awareness on Food Loss and throw away Reduction

stories.headline: UNHCR warns funding crisis could leave 8.3 million displaced people without vital aid
stories.summary: UNHCR warned that a severe funding shortfall could deprive 8.3 million refugees and forcibly displaced people of essential assistance in 2026.
key_takeaways: UNHCR reported a $5.789 billion funding shortfall.
Only 32% of the agency's $8.505 billion budget had been secured by July 2026.
The number of people under UNHCR's care could reach 131.2 million by year-end.

sources.title: UN agency warns funding crisis could leave 8.3 million people without aid

stories.headline: FAO says forest restoration window is narrowing as degradation accelerates
stories.summary: A UN Food and Agriculture Organization report warned that the window to restore the world's forests is narrowing after 489 million hectares were cleared since 1990 and only about one-fifth of pledged restoration has been achieved.
key_takeaways: More than 489 million hectares of forests have been cleared since 1990.
Only about 20% of pledged restoration has been achieved.
Restoring one billion hectares could yield about $1.8 trillion in annual benefits.

sources.title: UN warns of 'narrowing window' to restore world's forests

stories.headline: UN envoy meets Houthi negotiators as Yemen violence threatens Red Sea security
stories.summary: UN Yemen envoy Hans Grundberg met Houthi negotiators in Muscat and Saudi officials in an effort to prevent further escalation after a renewed surge in fighting.
key_takeaways: Hans Grundberg met Houthi negotiators in Muscat.
The escalation threatens maritime trade through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
More than 145,000 people were reported displaced within Yemen in the recent surge.

sources.title: UN envoy meets Houthi negotiators in a bid to halt escalating violence in Yemen

stories.headline: AI researchers warn companies are rushing toward self-improving systems without adequate safety safeguards
stories.summary: Current and former researchers linked to major AI labs warned that competitive pressure is driving rapid development of self-improving systems faster than safety and oversight frameworks are developing.
key_takeaways: Researchers warned that safety measures are not keeping pace with capability development.
Concerns include job displacement, loss of control and catastrophic risk.
The debate is tied to competitive pressure among major AI companies and states.

sources.title: AI researchers warn companies rushing self-improving systems despite safety risks

stories.headline: Spain, Portugal and Luxembourg press EU for a 2040 renewables target
stories.summary: Spain, Portugal and Luxembourg urged the European Union to adopt a dedicated renewable-energy target for 2040, arguing that it would provide investment certainty and reduce fossil-fuel dependence.
key_takeaways: Spain, Portugal and Luxembourg called for an EU 2040 renewables target.
The EU's current 2030 renewables target is 42.5%.
The proposal is linked to energy security and fossil-fuel dependence.

sources.title: Spain, Portugal and Luxembourg push for 2040 EU renewable energy target

stories.headline: India sends senior foreign-ministry official to Islamabad for SCO coordinators meeting
stories.summary: India sent a senior Ministry of External Affairs official to Islamabad for a Shanghai Cooperation Organisation coordinators meeting, creating a limited multilateral contact channel after a prolonged period of strained bilateral engagement.
key_takeaways: India sent a senior MEA official to Islamabad.
The meeting concerned SCO national coordinators.
The contact should not automatically be read as a broad bilateral thaw.
institutions: Ministry of External Affairs of India

sources.title: India sends senior MEA official to Pakistan for SCO coordinators meet
